concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE richly illustrated high-fidelity concept artwork preview of Sage's existing Middle-earth personal dashboard, landscape4:3 around1920x1440. Supplied image is LAYOUT AND QUALITY reference only; replace all Dwarven artwork and materials with the requested new theme. This is concept artwork only, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no floating boards, no palette chips. Mature premium fantasy craftsmanship with extraordinary scenic and object artwork, readable quiet panel interiors, real usable HTML-style labels rather than a generic SaaS page or game combat HUD.
Keep this same functional composition: full-height illustrated left sidebar about210px with theme crest at top, "THE COMMAND CENTER", "Personal" and "Work" switch; navigation "Overview", "Bag End", "Daily provisions", "WoW war room", "The Treasury"; matching Settings button at bottom. Add a distinctive lower-sidebar illustrated still life or architectural vignette tied to the theme, visible below the menus. A wide scenic header across main area has "Good evening, Sage", title "Sage’s Middle-earth", smaller "COMMAND CENTER", a seeing-stone search bar "Search the web..." and "Search" button. At top right show six compact theme choices "Hobbit", "Gondor", "Dwarven", "Elven", "Mordor", "One Ring"; highlight only the requested theme.
Below header: left column43% with "The Calendar" above "AI Tools"; right57% has "The Ravens" email panel rendered as a REAL OPEN ROLLED PARCHMENT SCROLL with cylindrical top and bottom rollers and themed crafted endcaps, NOT a rectangular cream card. Dark ink readable on pale ivory paper, text safely inside writing area. Ravens tabs "Primary", "Updates", three illustrative rows "Your weekly roundup", "An update from the fellowship", "Your next delivery", modest Refresh button. Calendar date tile "TUE" "17" "NOVEMBER", entries "09:00 Plan the day" and "14:00 Project time", "Open Google Calendar". AI Tools four quiet recognizable tiles "ChatGPT", "Claude", "Gemini", "Grok".
Next a compact full-width "Bag End" section with three equal-height readable inner cards "The hearth" (substantial crafted fireplace illustration plus70°F), "Weather in Rohan" (sun/cloud object plus64°F), "The watch at the gate" (rectangular landscape camera placeholder and Open camera button). Below a compact "The Quartermaster" row with Walmart+, Amazon, Sam's Club shortcuts. If space permits a tiny theme-specific footer emblem, NEVER the Elven Two Trees unless Elven selected.
Classical serif headings, restrained practical sans-serif UI text. Every frame edge, sidebar, icon, button, seeing stone, parchment roller and decorative emblem matches the selected new theme. Physical fills remain inside the borders. Main text cream/ivory with excellent contrast, labels never obscured by art. Ornamental material kept on rails/corners and margins, quiet inside content. Small meaningful distinct dimensional icons. Preserve existing English labels exactly, no extra sections. No gore, no tiny noisy runes behind labels, no decorative weapons overlapping controls, no generic gradient-only cards. Illustrative sample data only.
THEME: MORDOR. Selected "Mordor". Dark mythic volcanic grandeur, visually distinct from Dwarven bronze. Panoramic header looks across the ash plains toward Mount Doom's ember-lit summit and the distant needle silhouette of Barad-dûr, an abstract burning Eye near the FAR RIGHT, drifting ash and restrained smoky crimson sunset. Header left is calm dark for title overlay. Materials: weathered black obsidian and scorched volcanic stone, blackened iron and gunmetal frames, sharp gothic black-tower cornerwork; fine ember-orange fissures and sparse deep-red inset gems. Cream typography, red/orange used as subtle trim and small warm reflected glow rather than making every surface red. Sidebar top crest a tasteful fiery Eye medallion in black iron. Sidebar lower illustration a carved dark tower fragment, red-glass lantern, obsidian rock and a tiny contained ember fissure; no dwarf statue, no axes or gold foliage. Panel surfaces fine charcoal volcanic grain, cool near-black button centers with controlled ember edges. The email SCROLL has ivory ash-toned parchment and black iron/ruby roller endcaps; no burnt holes or ragged paper that damages usability. Hearth a small black-stone fireplace with contained amber fire; weather sun a restrained ember-gold sun; camera placeholder a peaceful dark mountain gate, not a real live feed. Borders architectural and angular, substantial but measured. Tiny footer emblem an ember Eye set into obsidian. Atmospheric, powerful, beautiful and comfortable to read—never an oversaturated lava-filled horror scene.

Panoramic header is an exquisite cinematic still life in an ancient shadowed chamber: the smooth glowing golden One Ring rests tilted on a small worn black stone pedestal toward the RIGHT, fine flowing Ring-script-inspired engraved strokes catching amber light, a delicate gold chain, distant misty blue mountain silhouettes and quiet dust motes; broad left side remains shadowed for readable title. Small object icons fashioned in gold and obsidian; settings gear fine gold, home doorway black stone with gold frame, treasury a quiet dark coffer with a single golden band. Buttons have black leather centers and slim polished gold band edges, selected states emit restrained amber. Theme-specific tiny footer is a single golden ring, NEVER a tree. Very refined, mysterious, cinematic, precious-artifact aesthetic; avoid excessive sparkle, orange lava or gratuitous flames.
